scope: Targeted checks ran against the complete private agent/payment runtimes.

findings.title: Introduced: agent hard-codes a 16384 output cap that an unpatched payer refuses; the ordering dependency is undocumented and each mis-ordered review fails terminally for its input hash
findings.disposition: Addressed in the deployment procedure: promote and verify the widened payment relay first; the agent promotion checks the exact live payment deployment/source. Rollback must restore the older agent before reverting the payment validator. No capability auto-fallback or smaller review is introduced.

findings.title: Unchanged mechanism, exposure widened: credit-lane telemetry reports effectiveMaxOutputTokens from the sent request and ignores the provider's x-si-adapted-params header
findings.disposition: Accepted telemetry limitation: effectiveMaxOutputTokens records the request sent, not proof of the provider internal cap. Completion and actual usage will be recorded from the genuine first calls; public documentation must not claim provider-adaptation verification.

findings.title: Unchanged limitation: the 600 s provider deadline is not widened with the 4x larger reasoning budget; a time-cut review still ends failed with its 2 USDC hold retained
findings.disposition: Accepted existing finite deadline and retained-uncertainty accounting. No timeout replay or hold release. Actual completion latency remains a live acceptance criterion.

findings.title: Unchanged limitation: the 2 USDC ceiling with no quote shrinking now applies to a 16384-token quote, narrowing the affordable input range by roughly 58261 microUSDC
findings.disposition: Accepted intended clean refusal under the unchanged 2-USDC maximum, with no shrinking, refill or disguised free allocation.

findings.title: Unchanged trust assumption, widened: the 16384 lane is selected by the caller-chosen Idempotency-Key pattern alone, so any INFERENCE_SECRET holder can obtain the widened budget
findings.disposition: Accepted trusted internal-secret boundary. This endpoint is not public inference; preserve the secret, finite per-call/lifetime limits and strict review-ID routing.

assessment.configurationCap: Review output intentionally has a separate finite code-bound budget; conversational maxOutputTokens remains unchanged.
assessment.scope: Exact three-file output-budget correction; runtime/API/intake source remains ea60511243d7478572bee344a00a52ff4e9b01b1.
